lines.coptic: Ⲁⲕⲥⲟⲗⲥⲉⲗ ⲛ̀ⲛⲉⲛⲯⲩⲭⲏ: ⲱ̀ Ⲙⲱⲩ̀ⲥⲏⲥ ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲫⲏⲧⲏⲥ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲡ̀ⲧⲁⲓⲟ ⲛ̀ϯⲥ̀ⲕⲏⲛⲏ: ⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲕⲥⲉⲗⲥⲱⲗⲥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.

translations.english: You decorated our souls, O Moses the prophet, by the honor of the tabernacle, which you have adorned.
translations.arabic: زينت نفوسنا، يا موسى النبي، بكرامة القبة، التي زينتها.

transliterations.english: Aksolsel ennenpsishee: o Mo-isees pi-eprofeetees: khen eptaio enti-eskeenee: etakselsols evol.

lines.coptic: Ϯⲥ̀ⲕⲏⲛⲏ ⲛ̀ϩⲟⲩⲓϯ: ⲉ̀ⲧⲁ Ⲙⲱⲩ̀ⲥⲏⲥ ⲑⲁⲙⲓⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲙⲁ ⲛ̀ⲭⲁⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲓⲥⲣⲁⲏⲗ.

translations.english: The first tabernacle, which Moses had made, was the place of the forgiveness, for the children of Israel.
translations.arabic: القبه الأولى، التي صنعها موسى، موضع مغفرة خطايا، بني إسرائيل.

transliterations.english: Ti-eskeenee enhouiti: eta Mo-isees thamios: enouma enkanovi evol: ente nensheeri empisraeel.

lines.coptic: Ⲁϥⲑⲁⲙⲓⲟⲥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲱ̀ⲟⲩ: ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲡ̀ⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲛⲓⲧⲩⲡⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ: ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥⲧⲁⲙⲟϥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲱⲟⲩ.

translations.english: He made it with glory, as commanded by the Lord, and according to the patterns, shown unto him.
translations.arabic: صنعها بمجد، كقول الرب، وكجميع المُثل، التي أعلمه بها.

transliterations.english: Afthamios khen o-oou: kata epsaji emepshois: nem kata nitipos teerou: etaftamof eroou.

lines.coptic: Ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲕⲓⲃⲱⲧⲟⲥ: ⲭⲏ ϧⲉⲛ ϯⲥ̀ⲕⲏⲛⲏ: ⲉⲥⲗⲁⲗⲏⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲃ: ⲥⲁϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲥⲁⲃⲟⲗ.

translations.english: There was an ark, in the tabernacle, overlaid with gold, from within and without.
translations.arabic: كان في القبة، تابوت مصَّفح، بالذهب من داخل، ومن خارج.

transliterations.english: O-on oukivotos: kee khen ti-eskeenee: eslaleeout ennoub: sakhoun nem savol.

sung.english: There was an ark, in the tabernacle, overlaid with gold, within and without.

lines.coptic: Ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲓ̀ⲗⲁⲥⲧⲏⲣⲓⲟⲛ: ⲭⲏ ϧⲉⲛ ϯⲥ̀ⲕⲏⲛⲏ: ϩⲁⲛⲬⲉⲣⲟⲩⲃⲓⲙ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲃ: ⲥⲉⲉⲣϧⲏⲓⲃⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱϥ.

translations.english: There was a mercy seat, in the tabernacle, and the golden Cherubim, overshadowed it.
translations.arabic: كان في القبة، غطاء وكاروبا، ذهب، يظللان عليه.

transliterations.english: O-on o-ilasteerion: kee khen ti-eskeenee: hansherouvim ennoub: se-erkheeivi egof.

lines.coptic: Ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲧⲁⲙⲛⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲃ: ⲭⲏ ϧⲉⲛ ϯⲥ̀ⲕⲏⲛⲏ: ⲉ̀ⲣⲉ ⲟⲩϣⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲛⲛⲁ ϩⲏⲡ: ⲛ̀ϧ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲛ̀ϧⲏⲧϥ.

translations.english: There was a golden pot, in the tabernacle, and a measure of the manna, was hidden in it.
translations.arabic: كان في القبة، قسط ذهبي، وكيل مَنَّ، مخفي فيه.

transliterations.english: O-on ou-estamnos ennoub: kee khen ti-eskeenee: ere oushi emmanna heep: enekhree enkheetf.

lines.coptic: Ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲗⲩⲭⲛⲓⲁ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲃ: ⲭⲏ ϧⲉⲛ ϯⲥ̀ⲕⲏⲛⲏ: ⲉ̀ⲣⲉ ⲡⲓϣⲁϣϥ ⲛ̀ϧⲏⲃⲥ: ⲉⲣⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲥ.

translations.english: There was a golden lampstand, in the tabernacle, and the seven lamps, shone upon it.
translations.arabic: كان في القبة، منارة من ذهب، وسبعة سُرج، تضئ عليها.

transliterations.english: O-on oulikhnia ennoub: kee khen ti-eskeenee: ere pishashf enkheevs: erowoini egos.

sung.english: There was a golden lampstand, in the tabernacle, and the seven lamps, shown upon it.

lines.coptic: Ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲟⲩϣⲟⲩⲣⲏ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲃ: ⲭⲏ ϧⲉⲛ ϯⲥ̀ⲕⲏⲛⲏ: ⲉ̀ⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲕⲩⲛⲁⲙⲱⲛⲟⲛ: ⲉⲧⲥⲱⲧⲡ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲉⲥⲙⲏϯ.

translations.english: There was a golden censer, in the tabernacle, and the chosen aloe, was in its midst.
translations.arabic: كان في القبة، مجمرة من ذهب، والعود المختار، في وسطها.

transliterations.english: O-on oushouree ennoub: kee khen ti-eskeenee: ere pikinamonon: etsotp khen tesmeeti.

lines.coptic: Ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲟⲩϩ̀ⲣⲏⲣⲓ ⲛ̀ⲥ̀ⲑⲟⲓⲛⲟⲩϥⲓ: ⲭⲏ ϧⲉⲛ ϯⲥ̀ⲕⲏⲛⲏ: ⲉⲩϣⲱⲗⲉⲙ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ: ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲁ ⲡ̀ⲏⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲓⲥⲣⲁⲏⲗ.

translations.english: There was a flower of incense, in the tabernacle, inhaled by all, the house of Israel.
translations.arabic: كان في القبة، زهرة بخور، يستنشق رائحتها، جميع آل بيت إسرائيل.

transliterations.english: O-on ou-ehreeri enestoinoufi: kee khen ti-eskeenee: evsholem eros teerou: enje na epee empisraeel.

sung.english: There was a flower of incense, in the tabernacle, smelled by all, the house of Israel.

lines.coptic: Ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲟⲩϣ̀ⲃⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲁ̀ⲁ̀ⲣⲱⲛ: ⲭⲏ ϧⲉⲛ ϯⲥ̀ⲕⲏⲛⲏ: ⲫⲁⲓ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥⲫⲓⲣⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ⲭⲱⲣⲓⲥ ϭⲟ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲧ̀ⲥⲟ.

translations.english: There was the rod of Aaron, in the tabernacle, this which has blossomed, without planting or watering.
translations.arabic: كان في القبة، عصا هرون، هذه التي أزهرت، بغير غرس ولا سقي.

transliterations.english: O-on ou-eshvot ente A-aron: kee khen ti-eskeenee: fai etaffiri evol: khoris cho nem etso.

lines.coptic: Ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲧ̀ⲣⲁⲡⲉⲍⲁ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲃ: ⲭⲏ ϧⲉⲛ ϯⲥ̀ⲕⲏⲛⲏ: ⲡ̀ⲱⲓⲕ ⲛ̀ϯⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲑⲉⲥⲓⲥ: ⲭⲏ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲥ.

translations.english: There was a golden table, in the tabernacle, and the oblation bread, was placed upon it.
translations.arabic: كان في القبة، مائدة ذهبية، وخبز التقدمة، موضوعاً عليها.

transliterations.english: O-on ou-etrapeza ennoub: kee khen ti-eskeenee: epoik enti-eprostesis: kee e-ehree egos.

lines.coptic: Ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲁⲣⲭⲏⲉ̀ⲣⲉⲩⲥ: ⲭⲏ ϧⲉⲛ ϯⲥ̀ⲕⲏⲛⲏ: ⲉϥⲉⲛ ϣⲟⲩϣⲱⲟⲩϣⲓ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ϣⲱⲓ: ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲗⲁⲟⲥ.

translations.english: There was a high priest, in the tabernacle, offering sacrifices, on account of the peoples sins.
translations.arabic: كان في القبة، رئيس كهنة، يُصعد الذبائح، عن خطايا الشعب.

transliterations.english: O-on o-arshee-erevs: kee khen ti-eskeenee: efen shoushooushi e-epshoi: ejen ninovi ente pilaos.

sung.english: There was a high priest, in the tabernacle, offering sacrifices, on account of the people's sins.

lines.coptic: Ⲁϥϣⲁⲛϣⲱⲗⲉⲙ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ: ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲡⲓⲡⲁⲛⲧⲟⲕⲣⲁⲧⲱⲣ: ϣⲁϥⲱ̀ⲗⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲩ: ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲗⲁⲟⲥ.

translations.english: When the Pantocrator, smelled the aroma, He lifted up the sins, of the people.
translations.arabic: إذا إشتم رائحتها، ضابط الكل، يرفع هنالك، خطايا الشعب.

transliterations.english: Afshansholem erof: enje Pipantokrator: shafoli emmav: enninovi ente pilaos.

sung.english: When the Almighty, smelled the aroma, He lifted up the sins, of the people.

lines.coptic: Ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ: ⲧ̀ϣⲉⲣⲓ ⲛ̀Ⲓⲱⲁⲕⲓⲙ: ⲁⲛⲥⲟⲩⲉⲛ Ⲡⲓϣⲟⲩϣⲱⲟⲩϣⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲭⲁⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.

translations.english: Through Mary, the daughter of Joachim, we learned of the true Sacrifice, for the forgiveness of sin.
translations.arabic: من قِبَل مريم، إبنة يواقيم، عرفنا الذبيحة الحقيقية، لمغفرة الخطايا.

transliterations.english: Evol hiten Maria: etsheri enyoakim: ansowen Pishoushooushi emmee: enkanovi evol.

sung.english: Through Mary, the daughter of Joachim, we learned of the true Sacrifice, for the forgiveness of sins.
